name: How to Restore Faded, Sun-Damaged Hardwood Floors in Edmonds Homes
title-tag: Restore Faded, Sun-Damaged Hardwood Floors | Edmonds WA
meta-description: Rug fade lines and yellowed floors are fixable: UV damage is shallow, and a full sand erases it. How we restore sun-damaged hardwood in Edmonds homes.
post-summary: September 11, 2026 · Sun fade lives in the wood, so no polish or recoat can fix it — but UV damage is shallow, and a full sand erases rug ghosts and yellowed finish completely. A restoration guide for Edmonds homes, where west light off the Sound does the damage and pre-war fir raises the stakes.
